scope: Current reduced one-axis axial-contact-force plant; 2 s loaded equilibrium, fixed robot, no drag. Not long-term normal-force or hardware qualification.
full_record_scoring: Every executed integration endpoint including startup and stopped endpoint, plus both force limits at rigid-envelope acceleration transitions; no full histories retained.
selection: Lowest ineligible-case count, then force-failure count, worst force error and largest mean hot winding loss; no evaluation retuning.

fixed_mechanics.external_B_S: rigid mounting with finite 64000000 N/m cell
fixed_mechanics.screw: Independent nut, internal 5000 N/m spring with zero damping, 10 mm/rev lead, 0.075 kg translating nut, total rotary inertia 7.04e-6 kg m2

causal_controller: Acquired gravity-tared cell plus identified S mass times acquired S acceleration; optional ordinary force PI/filter and acceleration-derived velocity/inertia terms. SEA also sampled quantized nut encoder and causal position servo. No bump profile, truth, preview or future motion.

root_contract.rigid_geometry: Ideal rigid77mm flat plate translating without tilt; analytic continuous maximum across the full footprint, not a finite-stiffness pad or old rigid-point branch
root_contract.rigid_force_limit: Envelope acceleration jumps2.4m/s2; two one-sided force limits differ by2.4*mS N, giving maximum error lower bound1.2*mS N independently of controller.

existing_no_pad_findings.scope: 8 unchanged old c80-gain rigid-point transfer diagnostics, not retuned current no-pad comparison

estimated_runtime: Approximately 2 to 4 minutes with four streaming C workers; original soft worst-case parity measured1.54/1.62s per serial record locally.
native_handoff: resolve_record(lock_path, record_id) reconstructs the exact selected config and retained full-step metrics; native worker owns command capture/replay storage.
